entries.title: Psalms 75:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. A Psalm. Of Asaph. A Song.> To you, O God, we give praise, to you we give praise: and those who give honour to your name make clear your works of power.

entries.title: Psalms 75:2
segments: When the right time has come, I will be the judge in righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 75:3
segments: When the earth and all its people become feeble, I am the support of its pillars. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 75:4
segments: I say to the men of pride, Let your pride be gone: and to the sinners, Let not your horn be lifted up.

entries.title: Psalms 75:5
segments: Let not your horn be lifted up: let no more words of pride come from your outstretched necks.

entries.title: Psalms 75:6
segments: ¶For honour does not come from the east, or from the west, or uplifting from the south;

entries.title: Psalms 75:7
segments: But God is the judge, putting down one, and lifting up another.

entries.title: Psalms 75:8
segments: For in the hand of the Lord is a cup, and the wine is red; it is well mixed, overflowing from his hand: he will make all the sinners of the earth take of it, even to the last drop.

entries.title: Psalms 75:9
segments: But I will ever be full of joy, making songs of praise to the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 75:10
segments: By him will all the horns of the sinners be cut off; but the horns of the upright will be lifted up.
